outcome: Mortality rate associated with peripartum hysterectomy
cohort: Women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy in Slovakia between January 2012 and December 2020
finding: The incidence of peripartum hysterectomy in Slovakia was found to be relatively high (0.91 per 1000 births) and was associated with advanced maternal age, multiparity, multiple pregnancies, and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were associated with a higher incidence of peripartum hysterectomy.
